proposals.title: Proposal 5 — Equal Voting Rights for Each Share
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to ensure all outstanding stock has one vote per share, including encouraging holders of multiple-vote shares to relinquish those rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 5 because it is not in the best interests of Ford or its shareholders.

proposals.title: Proposal 6 — Child Labor Audit
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Ford to report on the extent its electric vehicle and charging station business plans may rely on child labor outside the United States.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 6 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and its shareholders.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 — Supply Chain Transparency and Traceability Report
proposals.proponent: Green Century Capital Management, on behalf of Dunkelman Descendants Trust FBO Zane Behnke
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Ford to report on aluminum, steel, mineral, rubber and leather supply chains regarding deforestation risk, GHG emissions and sustainable material procurement targets.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 7 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and its shareholders.
